falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes more than 4% below its level at the start of the 14-day window on any session, with NYSE advance/decline ratio below 0.5 that same day
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sharp, broad breakdown would show this is not a bottom_2024_aug-style stabilization; HOLD/UNKNOWN would be wrong because the tape resolved clearly risk-off

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score prints at or above 70 on any day in the next 14 days while the S&P 500 makes a new 20-day high
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A high blowoff reading into new highs would contradict both the low blowoff score (38) and the bottom-pattern match, proving the setup was a late-cycle extension rather than an unresolved bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 28 and high-yield credit spreads (ICE BofA US HY OAS) widen by 75 basis points or more versus the start of the window, both occurring within the same 5-session span
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A joint vol and credit stress spike would invalidate the HOLD and the 77% bottom analog, because August 2024-style bottoms did not feature simultaneous volatility and spread blowouts of that size without a directional risk-off call

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
